title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from the surrounding pages): X is the Deligne–Mumford compactification of M_{g,ν}, or more generally a smooth space or stack with a normal-crossings boundary divisor and its stratification. Σ, Σ', Σ'' are 'admissible' closed parts, i.e. unions of closed strata. For Σ' ⊂ Σ'', V_{Σ',Σ''} is the topos or homotopy type of a tubular neighbourhood of Σ' inside Σ''. Definition (257) on the previous page sets V^Σ_{Σ',Σ''} := V_{Σ',Σ''} \ V_{Σ',Σ''∩Σ}, the neighbourhood with the part lying over Σ removed. For example, V^*_{Θ,X} for a smooth divisor Θ is the deleted tubular neighbourhood, a punctured-disc bundle over Θ. The variant (258) is V^{Σ\Σ∩Σ'_0}_{Σ'\Σ'_0, Σ''\Σ'_0} for an admissible Σ'_0 ⊂ Σ'.

This page makes two reduction remarks.
(1) Type (258) is just type (257) computed in the open stratified space X\Σ'_0. One replaces (X, Σ', Σ'', Σ) by (X\Σ'_0, Σ'\Σ'_0, Σ''\Σ'_0, Σ\Σ∩Σ'_0). To make this effective, the formalism must describe explicitly what happens on passing to the complement of an admissible part (deferred: 'il faudra y revenir').
(2) The general V^Σ_{Σ',Σ''} reduces to the case Σ''=X, provided one can make explicit the passage from the ambient X to a closed admissible Σ''. Σ'' is then treated as a new ambient space, itself stratified by the induced strata.

A parenthetical remarks that certain hypotheses (or neighbourhoods, reading uncertain) have long since stopped playing a role. Grothendieck believes the passage to Σ'' has already been done for the systems D_{d_0…d_r}^{Σ''}. These are the boundary strata indexed by tuples d_0,…,d_r that reappear on the next page as V^*_{d_0,…,d_r}.

The page ends by announcing the next page's point. At the level of topoi it suffices in principle to capture the V_{Σ',Σ''} and the transition morphisms for inclusions of pairs. The difficulty is making this explicit at the level of fundamental groupoids.

Purpose: a small 'programme' to compute all the local homotopy types at infinity of M_{g,ν}, and in particular their π_1 (subgroupoids of the Teichmüller groupoid). Everything is to be expressed in terms of the basic deleted-neighbourhood types of the boundary strata.
errors: No mathematical error. The reductions are formally correct, but they rely on two unproved 'explicitation' steps: restriction to an open complement, and change of ambient space to a closed admissible Σ''. Grothendieck himself flags both as to be done later.

The reduction to Σ''=X requires Σ'' with its induced stratification to behave like an ambient space. For a normal-crossings union of strata this means working with self-intersecting (non-smooth) ambient spaces, so local models must be handled via normalisation and branches. This is left implicit.

ideas.what: Reducing neighbourhood types of a stratum relative to a closed union of strata in an open complement to the same construction in the open stratified space X\Σ'_0.
ideas.modern_name: Restriction of stratified homotopy types / exit-path data to open unions of strata (functoriality of homotopy links)

ideas.what: Reducing V^Σ_{Σ',Σ''} to the case of ambient Σ''=X by treating a closed admissible part as a new ambient stratified space.
ideas.modern_name: Restriction of a stratified space to a closed union of strata (closed sub-poset of strata)

ideas.what: The programme of describing all local homotopy types at infinity of M_{g,ν}, with their π_1, via the topoi V_{Σ',Σ''} and their transition maps indexed by inclusions of pairs.
ideas.modern_name: Structure at infinity of moduli / Teichmüller groupoid and tangential base points at boundary strata
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse), later Ihara, Nakamura, Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps, Bakalov–Kirillov
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), sections on the Teichmüller tower and structure at infinity; details unsure

deep.surprise_reason: This is bookkeeping inside a known Grothendieck programme: formal reductions between variants of neighbourhood topoi of strata. The content is routine from the viewpoint of modern stratified homotopy theory, and the page explicitly defers the substantive steps.
transcription_corrections: Line 3: the replacement is (X, Σ', Σ'', Σ) → (X\Σ'_0, Σ'\Σ'_0, Σ''\Σ'_0, Σ\Σ∩Σ'_0), consistent with (258). It is not 'Σ''\Σ_0'', Σ\Σ_0'.

'systèmes de Dedekind^{Σ''}' is almost certainly 'systèmes D_{d_0…d_r}^{Σ''}' (written 'Dd0-dr'), i.e. the boundary strata indexed by d_0,…,d_r that appear on the next page as V^*_{d_0,…,d_r}. Dedekind is not involved.

The parenthetical is very uncertain. 'on prend des hyp. … plutôt des voisinages … qui aient un sens' may read 'on prend des hypothèses …'; the closing 'elles n'ont plus de rôle depuis belle lurette!' is fairly clear.
